sa_is123_bandicoot.desc: bandicoot pictogram, green (traced from the sheet's filled artwork)

notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. DIT symbol sheet (Symbol Series: a sign component published as its own drawing; contact DIT before use). Sheet IS123 (interpretive-series symbol): a green pictogram on a 420 x 350 grid box (no plate — the ground is whatever sign carries it), so the file is the box with a transparent ground; the box is located from the sheet's dotted grid. Layout: 420 x 350, transparent outside the artwork, R0, no border. The board is located by its drawn outline; its artwork (bandicoot pictogram, green) is taken from the sheet's own filled shapes (PDF fills rendered at 1000 dpi without the dimension lines, traced), ink box x -0-420, y 66-285.
